settings.heading: The Poetry of Handcrafted Living
settings.subheading: Bridging centuries of Indian ancestral weaving traditions with modern architectural serenity for the global home.

settings.heading: Weaving Dignity, Knot by Sacred Knot
settings.quote: A rug is not merely wool on cotton; it is the heartbeat and dreams of a family manifested in pattern.
When my fingers guide the wool across the warp, I am not alone at the loom. My grandmother sits beside me in memory, and the home across the sea that will cherish this carpet is already in my heart.
settings.author: Shanti Devi
settings.village: Master Weaver & Artisan Guild Leader, Aaspura
